title: P007 direct-source function certification, wave 2 (next 200 of the 606-row backlog)

scope.summary: Certify occurrence-level particle identity and contextual function for the next 200 rows of the p007 (entry b10a1ee04666) direct-source-attested-function partition, reusing the wave-1 method unchanged: one surface-matched Tafsir MCP analyze_word call per row, verbatim evidence capture, typed-fact certification via the repo certifier in candidate lane mode.
out_of_scope: governor_relation, governed_expression, case/mood, attachment, scope: these stay review_required and route to the two-vote queue exactly as in wave 1
any live-surface mutation, entry-store write, or whitelist change
re-classification of the 2,999-row population (the partition file is input, never output)

tools_required: mcp__tafsir__analyze_word (Tafsir MCP; warm up with fetch_ayah(1,1) first)

commands.purpose: Derive the wave-2 worklist: all 866 direct-source rows in canonical loc order, minus the 260 covered by wave 1 (committed coverage manifest), first 200 of the remainder
commands.expect: exactly 200 rows; the exclusion set is the committed manifest's 260 covered_locs — never guess wave-1 coverage

commands.purpose: Per row: one MCP analyze_word(aspects=['irab','sarf']) call; loose-normalize the returned word against the row surface; record verbatim to the evidence file with sha256
commands.expect: one verbatim JSONL evidence row per call in mcp-evidence-w2.jsonl; surface mismatch => row marked index_mismatch and NOT certified

commands.purpose: Build typed facts and certify: particle_identity + contextual_function per row on direct_source_attestation; governor_relation registered review_required
commands.expect: up to 400 certified facts (2 per confirmed row); certifier refusals are recorded, never bypassed

commands.purpose: Validate the event trail and count
commands.run: python tools/certify_typed_fact.py --validate qamus/certification/p007-direct-source-w2 && python tools/certify_typed_fact.py --count qamus/certification/p007-direct-source-w2
commands.expect: OK: certification event trail is valid; count == 2 x jarr-confirmed rows

candidate_population.selection_rule: Sort the 866 rows with partition == direct-source-attested-function by canonical loc (surah, ayah, word as integers, ascending). Remove every canonical_loc present in the committed wave-1 coverage manifest qamus/task-packets/tp-p007-ds-w1-covered-locs.json (260 rows: the wave-1 fresh-200 worklist plus the sample-60). Take the first 200 remaining. Deterministic: two executors given the same inputs must produce the identical worklist.

expected_outputs.description: the 200-row worklist with per-row loc/surface/route/matrix_id and the exclusion audit (input hashes)
verbatim MCP evidence, one row per call, sha256 per row
typed facts (particle_identity, contextual_function per confirmed row; governor_relation review_required)
wave report card mirroring the wave-1 sections: counts, reroutes, index mismatches, MCP budget, defects, remaining backlog (must compute 606-minus-confirmed)

evidence_policy.statement: Per-row verbatim MCP evidence is mandatory before any certification. The returned word is loose-normalized and surface-matched against the row surface; index positions are never trusted. Function certification relies on the owner's function-certification rung ruling (Rate-limit handoff rulings 2026-07-29, handoff-steer section 20/26, recorded in the owner decision ledger): an exact, surface-matched source statement of harf jarr MAY certify occurrence-level contextual_function via direct_source_attestation — it does NOT auto-certify governor/governed/attachment/case sign/scope/sense nuance, which keep their own policies (two-vote queue).
evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If an MCP call fails after 3 bounded retries, or the returned word does not surface-match, the row is marked evidence_gap/index_mismatch and skipped — never certified, never filled from memory. Fabricating or paraphrasing source content voids the whole wave.

guards: The METHOD of wave 1 transfers; its linguistic conclusions do not — every row gets its own MCP evidence and its own per-row predicate check (the initial la/li is a prepositional clitic governing jarr on the attached host).
The typed fact never exceeds the source: certify only what the source states at this exact occurrence.
Certifier refusals are the system working: a refused fact stays refused and is reported, never re-worded to pass.
Candidate lane mode throughout: the lane store is new files under qamus/certification/p007-direct-source-w2/ only; committed entry states and live surfaces are untouched.
No private corpus names or server paths in any output (FORBIDDEN_LABELS / RM-09); evidence refs use opaque packet designations.
defeaters: Lexical-initial lam: the whole token is a noun whose first radical letter is lam (model: surface libas at quran:2:187:9 — MCP sarf reads the whole token as a noun, wazn fi3al, no jarr-harf clause). Clitic carve REJECTED, row rerouted rejected-false-candidate.
Lam of ta'lil over a verb host (model: quran:48:29:42 — jarr harf but host is mudari' mansub over implied 'an): outside this packet's noun/pronoun/mawsul host routes; reroute, do not certify.
Index mismatch: MCP word at the requested index differs from the row surface — resolve by surface search within the ayah or mark index_mismatch (wave-1 precedent: 5:1:11).
Multi-particle claim flags (e.g. multi_particle_claims on the row): certify only the p007 lam edge; never let one MCP call certify a second particle's claim.

positive.expectation: jarr-la-allomorph-pronoun-host route; MCP irab states harf jarr; both facts certify on direct_source_attestation; governor stays review_required
already geometry-certified fused clitic; if selected for spot-comparison the method must reproduce the pilot's jarr reading exactly

adversarial.expectation: MUST be rejected (lexical-initial lam, not a clitic). It is not in the direct-source partition; if it appears in any generated worklist the selection step is broken — STOP and escalate
MUST NOT be certified under this packet (verb host, lam ta'lil). Appearing in the worklist means the partition filter was ignored — STOP and escalate

acceptance_tests.name: worklist determinism
acceptance_tests.run: re-run the selection command into a temp file and diff against wave2-worklist.json

acceptance_tests.name: event trail valid
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0 and 'OK: certification event trail is valid'

acceptance_tests.name: evidence completeness
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: every certified fact's occurrence has a verbatim evidence row with matching surface and sha256

non_deployment.statement: Candidate mode throughout: nothing in this packet mutates any live surface, committed entry state, whitelist row, or the population classification. Outputs are a lane-local certification store and a report; any deploy of resulting facts is a separate owner-gated decision.

conditions: the committed wave-1 coverage manifest qamus/task-packets/tp-p007-ds-w1-covered-locs.json is missing, fails to parse, or does not carry exactly 260 covered_locs — selection cannot be made deterministic without it (RESOLVED for the normal case by the committed manifest; this trigger now guards corruption, not absence)
any adversarial canary row appears in the generated worklist
more than 5 index mismatches or more than 5 MCP failures in a single batch (systematic source problem)
any row where the source states a function OTHER than harf jarr (reroute candidate: report, do not certify, do not re-partition unilaterally)
the certifier refuses a fact the packet expects to certify (policy drift — needs certifier-lane review)
escalation_trigger.route: STOP the affected batch; write a stop-report to qamus/reports/p007-direct-source-w2.md (defects section) and hand back to the Fusha certifier lane; the arbitration/decision authority is the owner decision ledger process, never this packet's executor

definition_of_done: 200-row worklist committed with deterministic selection audit
per-row verbatim evidence committed (or explicit evidence_gap/index_mismatch marks)
typed facts + hash-chained events validate with tools/certify_typed_fact.py
wave report card committed with the same section structure as wave 1, including remaining-backlog arithmetic (606 - confirmed)
zero writes outside the permitted paths
